users: researchers inspecting archived multimodal flow-loop analysis notebooks
supported_tasks: review existing flow-loop and accelerometer analysis materials
identify candidate workflow components for reproduction
not_intended_for: a current maintained data-acquisition system, a validated flow-loop result, or reuse of any underlying experiment data without separate rights and provenance review

limitations: The top-level repository documentation provides only a minimal description of its scope and current maintenance state.
Data provenance, calibration, synchronization, and evaluation boundaries must be established before quantitative reuse.
